notable: The site splits him into three name clusters (231550, 315193, 323489). Cluster 315193's heading misspells his name as 'Samuel Lanhorne Clemens'. Most of the descriptive values (bio, birth and death places, occupations, Faulkner) come from an embedded Italian Wikipedia summary (xhr_1.json), not from Parsifal's own cataloguing. The work sample 'Adventures of Tom Sawyer. 1999' carries the year in the title, which is cosmetic.

label: PMB – Personen der Moderne Basis person ID
missing: Nothing substantial. The page shows 4 place relations and 2 work relations, and all of them are captured. Related datasets such as wiengeschichtewiki and schnitzler-tagebuch appear only as link names in the page text.

That is a minor misclassification, since they are PMB collections, not people. The stays at Hotel Metropole [Wien] (1897–1899) and Hotel Kaiserin Elisabeth [Bad Ischl] are information this site uniquely provides.
